basis.rule: proof generation is an out-of-band artifact-production job; proof availability is checked by content hash and never awaited as an inline proving service
epoch proofs are produced on a fixed schedule by a dedicated proving job and archived by hash

proof_artifact_consumption_contract.budget_scope: The 12-hour proof/relay wait is an explicit external-artifact budget and is excluded from the under-10-minute active browser lifecycle budget in recovery spec section 12.
required_completion_checks: proof artifact content hash matches the durable job
public-values hash and byte length match the request
program vkey and Groth16 selector match the pinned verifier
receipt, packet, route, recipient, amount, and checkpoint bindings match
real verifier acceptance and downstream relay receipt are observed
proof_artifact_consumption_contract.timeout_action: STOP-no-retry; preserve the durable job, proof request, browser state, proxy state, and rehearsal environment; record the first failing check before any new run
proof_artifact_consumption_contract.restart_contract: proxy restart and browser reload resume polling the same durable job id and never launch or duplicate proof generation
